skillDescriptions.one: A beginner who is learning basic strokes, serves, scoring, and court movement.
skillDescriptions.oneFive: A beginner who can rally occasionally and is starting to build more reliable strokes and serves.
skillDescriptions.two: An advanced beginner who can sustain short rallies but is still developing consistent strokes, serves, and court movement.
skillDescriptions.twoFive: A developing player with improving consistency, basic placement, and more confidence in casual rallies.
skillDescriptions.three: An intermediate player with reliable strokes, improved placement, and enough consistency for longer rallies.
skillDescriptions.threeFive: A strong intermediate player with consistent rallies, better shot selection, and growing match strategy.
skillDescriptions.four: An advanced player with strong consistency, controlled pace, match strategy, and confident court coverage.
